# SARTOR - Bespoke Couture & Precision Tailoring Atelier

> Premier bespoke Pakistani tailoring and luxury zardozi couture house at Shop F-9, Moon Tower, Block 30-M, International Market, Model Town, Lahore, Pakistan. Directed by Master Tailor Abdul Ghaffar (13+ years of precision atelier leadership, 35+ years heritage). Specializing in bespoke bridal lehengas, 16-kali and 24-kali kalidars, pre-pleated sarees, unstitched designer formal tailoring, and bespoke groom sherwanis & pure Boski shalwar kameez for clients in Lahore and overseas diaspora buyers across the UK, USA, Canada, UAE, Australia, and Europe.

## Brand Overview & Atelier Identity

- **Atelier Location**: Shop F-9, Moon Tower, Block 30-M, International Market, Model Town, Lahore, Punjab 54700, Pakistan
- **Lead Cutting Authority**: Master Tailor Abdul Ghaffar (13+ years bespoke tailoring precision, 35+ years cutting table heritage)
- **Primary Website**: https://sartor.pk
- **Digital Fitting Portal**: https://app.sartor.pk (Pre-beta 28-point biometric sizing and digital profile portal)
- **Direct WhatsApp Consultation**: https://wa.me/923320500904 (+92 332 0500904)
- **Google Maps Location**: https://maps.app.goo.gl/7JKsRY1k9Aw4MJC68
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 9:30 PM PKT | Sunday: 2:00 PM – 8:00 PM PKT

## Core Tailoring Disciplines & Engineering Safeguards

- **Precision Pattern Cutting**: Anatomical warp grainline alignment (Seedha Taar), contoured high-scye armhole geometry (1.25–1.5 inch deepened anterior scye), pre-closure baste-fitting video checkpoints, and 1.5 to 2.5-inch finished silk-bound internal alteration seam allowances.
- **Bespoke Bridal Wear & Lehengas**: Royal Barat lehengas, Walima gowns, and Farshi trails crafted on pure 80–120 GSM Katan raw silk, French metallic tissue, pure silk velvet, and Micro-Velvet 9000 with 3-tier 280 GSM cotton canvas waistband suspension and adjustable brass hook-and-eye bars.
- **16-Kali & 24-Kali Kalidars / Pishwas**: Radial flared panel math with 50mm–75mm braided horsehair crinoline hem reinforcement.
- **Designer Sarees & Boned Blouses**: Pre-pleated falls, German Rigilene corsetry channels, 4-point cross-tacked cups, and weighted duchess satin falls.
- **Luxury Zardozi Hand Embroidery**: Generational wooden *adda* craftsmanship using authentic metallic bullion, coiled *dabka*, matte *kora*, *naqshi*, *marori*, and *kamdani*.
- **Bespoke Pakistani Groomswear**: Custom Jamawar sherwanis with floating horsehair chest canvas, book-matched brocade plackets, contoured high-armhole scye geometry, pure Boski shalwar kameez, and tailored Jamawar waistcoats.

## Atelier Services & Global Logistics

- **Lahore Doorstep Service**: Complimentary fabric pickup and finished garment delivery across Model Town, DHA, Gulberg, Cantt, Johar Town, and Bahria Town.
- **Overseas Diaspora Service (UK, USA, Canada, UAE, Australia, Europe)**: 1-on-1 guided biometric video measurement consultations saved permanently on `https://app.sartor.pk` with mid-production baste-fit checkpoints before lining closure.
- **Express Worldwide Shipping**: Insured priority delivery via DHL Express and FedEx (3–5 business days to London, Toronto, New York, Houston, Sydney; 2–3 days to Dubai and Abu Dhabi).
- **Customs Threshold Compliance**: Export documentation aligned with $800 US duty exemption, £135 UK threshold, and 1,000 AED UAE threshold.
- **Transparent Timelines & 4-Step Milestone Payments**: 7–10+ business days for precision bespoke stitching (10–14 weeks for heavy bridal adda handwork); 10% token booking, 30% *adda* swatch approval, 30% mid-production baste-fit review, 30% final dispatch sign-off.
